contracts.declared_mechanism: `_resolve_attachments` (manager.py:141-185): (1) raw-string prefix check against `_OUTPUTS_VIRTUAL_PREFIX = "/mnt/user-data/outputs/"` with skip-and-warning on mismatch; (2) `Paths.resolve_virtual_path`, which requires a segment-boundary `/mnt/user-data` prefix match and raises ValueError 'Access denied: path traversal detected' if the resolved path escapes the thread's user-data base (paths.py:158-191); (3) a post-resolve containment re-check `actual.resolve().relative_to(outputs_dir)` against `paths.sandbox_outputs_dir(thread_id).resolve()`; (4) an `actual.is_file()` existence check. Any failure skips that artifact and logs a warning; only passing paths become ResolvedAttachment entries.

scope_limits: Guard runs only in the IM-channel chat dispatch path (`_handle_chat`); the `/command` path (`_handle_command`, manager.py:420-457) publishes outbound messages without attachment resolution and without this guard.

Rejection is per-artifact skip-and-warn: the outbound message is still published, and filenames of rejected/unresolved artifacts are appended to the response text (manager.py:389-398), so rejected file names may be disclosed as text even though their contents are not attached.
The guard filters only artifact paths extracted from `present_files` tool calls by `_extract_artifacts`; response text and other message content are not filtered.
The prefix check is a raw-string `startswith` performed before resolution; traversal defense depends on `resolve_virtual_path` plus the containment re-check.
Containment is scoped to the thread-specific outputs directory derived from `thread_id`; `thread_id` charset is restricted by `_SAFE_THREAD_ID_RE` in `Paths.thread_dir` (paths.py:105-107).
Enforcement occurs at attachment-resolution time host-side; no supplied source shows re-validation at the actual upload site.
